description: Dense int splice: construction, signed range removal/insertion and complete removed/receiver retention
operationUnit: One actual Array.splice with omitted/explicit arguments; fresh receiver/argument construction, full removed and final receiver serialization, and output retention included.
specification: Receiver sizes0/1/4/5/17; no-argument no-op, omitted-delete tail removal, strict signed start/delete clamping, and zero/one/three ordered front insertion items. Two length markers plus every removed and final receiver element retained; variable output2+initialReceiverSize+insertedCount.
notes: All setup, range selection, removal/insertion, conversion and retention are timed. Removed owned values transfer naturally; fresh owned inserted items consumed by native splice, JS ordinary references. Full nested leaf/record field order retained. Number[] preserves signed zero and canonical NaN/infinity through existing IEEE observer. No isolated method latency, reference identity or allocation parity claim.
